contributor_context: Issue-solving Agents operate with narrow task context and should not require a complete model of noodles. The repository therefore bounds document traversal and routes work toward the nearest executable authority.
design_objective: Make the locally obvious noodles change the globally correct change without laundering guidance into verification authority.

invariants.title: Conventional path first
invariants.statement: The supported path should require fewer decisions than a shortcut.

invariants.title: Mechanical rejection
invariants.statement: Forbidden structural or authority states should fail at deterministic/provider boundaries with supported-path diagnostics.

invariants.title: One admitted writer
invariants.statement: Every durable truth has one obvious owner and admitted mutation or transition surface.

invariants.title: Isolation
invariants.statement: Local mutation is isolated from shared control surfaces; this does not imply Dune-style feature-owned source topology.

invariants.title: Explicit exceptions
invariants.statement: Bootstrap, recovery, and cross-boundary exceptions remain explicit, bounded, and evidence-gated.

carriers.name: Exact GitHub Issue
carriers.responsibility: Names one repository-mutating atom, target, lifecycle, dependencies and optional component/feature boundary.

carriers.name: Noodle-owned worktree
carriers.responsibility: Contains repository mutation away from the shared control checkout.

carriers.name: Nearest executable contract/test/oracle
carriers.responsibility: Carries target-local deterministic acceptance instead of relying on prose.

carriers.name: Durable owner/writer map
carriers.responsibility: Separates system intent, Issue lifecycle, scheduling/worktrees, candidate source, provider reality and reconciliation authorities.

carriers.name: Trusted GitHub verification and landing
carriers.responsibility: Binds exact-head provider admission, merge and closure reality.

claims.semantic_kernel: Narrow-context contributors need a bounded route to the nearest relevant authority.
claims.domain_realization: AGENTS.md -> system contract when needed -> issue-named executable contract/test, maximum three nodes.
negative_claims: The route test proves Agent comprehension.
claims.best_path_consequence: Stop architecture-document traversal after the issue-selected executable boundary.

claims.semantic_kernel: The conventional path should be easier than shortcuts and completion should mean physically/provider verified completion.
claims.domain_realization: Exact Issue -> isolated worktree -> nearest executable boundary -> exact-head local evidence -> trusted GitHub landing/readback -> reconciliation.
negative_claims: The end-to-end route is one mechanically guaranteed local gate.
claims.best_path_consequence: Follow the exact Issue and provider-bound path; distinguish P routing, L local evidence, and R provider reality.

claims.semantic_kernel: Known invalid states should fail mechanically where possible.
claims.domain_realization: Repository verification, exact parsers, structural checks, dependency restrictions and trusted provider gates reject classes of invalid states.
negative_claims: Every architecture invariant is mechanically enforced.
All fitness thresholds are hard gates.
claims.best_path_consequence: Prefer an existing deterministic rejection seam over adding prose; preserve each gate's exact evidence ceiling.

claims.semantic_kernel: Durable truth should have one obvious writer/transition surface.
claims.domain_realization: The system contract separates owners and admitted transitions; concrete single-source rules such as task-profile literals are mechanically checked.
negative_claims: Repository-wide semantic duplicate-writer detection is complete.
claims.best_path_consequence: Mutate durable truth only through its admitted owner/transition; treat undocumented duplicate-writer coverage as UNKNOWN.

claims.semantic_kernel: Local work should not accumulate uncontrolled mutation in shared surfaces.
claims.domain_realization: Noodles isolates repository mutation in Noodle-owned worktrees and bounds ordinary mutations by declared component surfaces.
negative_claims: Noodles implements Dune Feature-owned folders and reserved-file auto-discovery.
claims.best_path_consequence: Use the isolated worktree and declared component; do not infer product-source topology that is not evidenced.

claims.semantic_kernel: Exceptions should be narrow, explicit and unable to become a second normal path by precedent.
claims.domain_realization: Bootstrap/recovery atoms and trusted transitions are explicitly bounded; cross-component contract work is an admitted escape that relies on surrounding gates.
negative_claims: contract:* is itself a narrow path glob.
An exception can silently become the default path.
claims.best_path_consequence: Use normal component paths by default; treat broad contract scope as an explicit exception requiring the full admission/proof path.

divergences: Dune shapes product source topology with Feature-owned folders, reserved-file discovery, Client/Host contracts and package direction; noodles primarily shapes Issue/worktree/component/evidence/provider topology.
Noodles adds explicit P/L/R/N authority separation and exact-subject provider evidence binding beyond the supplied Dune excerpt.
Noodles complexity metrics include advisory N-class warnings; they are not all equivalent to Dune mechanical constraints.
negative_claims: Prose or model consensus is enforcement.
All fitness thresholds are hard gates.
The contract component makes unrestricted cross-component mutation normal.
One-writer is fully mechanically proven repository-wide.
best_path: Start from the exact Issue and declared component/feature markers.
Use the Noodle-owned isolated worktree; never mutate the shared control checkout.
Read AGENTS.md, then the system contract only when required, then the issue-selected executable contract/test; stop traversal.
Implement the smallest independently useful atom.
Run mandatory baseline acceptance plus every applicable specialized physical oracle.
Bind evidence to the exact candidate head/tree.
Use trusted GitHub verification, exact-head landing and provider readback for repository completion.
Reconcile local state only after provider reality is read back.
